KeysToEntries.ID_COMING_FEATURES_CODEX_DESCRIPTION: Your own RAIDER LOG will hold all the things you learn about ARC, The Rust Belt, Toledo, Speranza & its inhabitants.
KeysToEntries.ID_COMING_FEATURES_DEN_DESCRIPTION:
Home sweet home!
This is your RAIDEN DEN, your personal space in the bustling neighbourhood of Speranza. This is a place you can shape to your taste.
KeysToEntries.ID_COMING_FEATURES_STORE_DESCRIPTION: Here you will be able to buy various items, including things to equip your RAIDER with and to use in customizing your RAIDER DEN.
KeysToEntries.ID_COMING_FEATURES_TRADING_DESCRIPTION: At the shady SPERANZA PIAZZA you will be able to trade with other RAIDERS.
